messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] P1 - elevated 5xx for tenant 'aurora-prod' in us-west-2 VPC (edge-proxy). Incident created. Pager: @tina. Link: https://incidents.redwood/2468101214 :rotating_light:
tina: on it, joining call. grabbing metrics + logs.
ravi: I'm in. checking dedicated pool dp-aurora-west, pulling topo and kernel logs.
jordi: net team checking BGP/edge peering for us-west-2-edge-*. saw a small route flap 00:02 UTC but stabilized. nothing obvious yet.
mel: platform - warm capacity reserved in eu-west-1 for Aurora (rp-eu-aurora). Confirming model and cache readiness.
Amber - Aurora: We started getting customer alerts ~2m ago. Reported symptoms: 503 on session create, intermittent timeouts. Severity: customer-wide for their prod tenant. We're on standby to coordinate.
tina: quick impact summary: error rate ~12% aggregated for aurora-prod in us-west-2 (spike last 6m). Latency up for new sessions. Existing sessions mostly OK.
ravi: logs: upstream TLS handshake timeouts between proxy and backend -> 502/503. Connections from specific proxy nodes show elevated RST. No obvious OOM on GPUs.
jordi: routing: I can perform weighted traffic shift via traffic-router. Suggest incremental: 10% -> 50% -> 100% to eu warm pool with health checks. Need platform + support OK.
mel: warm pool eu-west-1 has model v3.2 loaded, KV cache primed, and readiness probes green. Autoscaler standing by if we need more capacity.
tina: plan (high level): 1) drain suspect backend instance(s) in dp-aurora-west for deeper inspection; 2) start gradual traffic shift to eu warm pool; 3) lower DNS TTL with Aurora SRE if needed; 4) full cutover only if health checks pass. Owners: drain=ravi, traffic=jordi, dns=Amber/Aurora.
Amber - Aurora: Aur SRE will lower TTL to 30s once you confirm readiness. They asked for a short maintenance note posted to them before DNS changes.
deploy-bot: Canary shift command queued by jordi. Command: ```traffic-router update aurora-prod --weights us-west-2=90,eu-west-1=10 --health-check 15s --auto-rollback on-fail```
ravi: starting drain on node dp-aurora-west-3 -> marking as DRAINING. backing off new sessions.
tina: watching error rate after 10% shift. set alert: auto-rollback if 5xx > 5% for 3 consecutive checks.
ops-bot: monitoring: after 10% shift, 5xx dropped from 12% -> ~6.8% within 90s.
Amber - Aurora: SRE lowered TTL to 30s. They're standing by for a DNS update if you choose that path, but prefer we use weighted routing first.
jordi: proceeding to 50/50 now: `traffic-router update aurora-prod --weights us-west-2=50,eu-west-1=50`
ravi: backend logs look stable on eu warm nodes. small increase in cold-start latency but within SLO.
tina: after 50% shift error rate ~1.5% and trending down. rolling to 100% in 2m unless objections.
Amber - Aurora: we're seeing customer-side error reports drop significantly. Some long-lived websocket clients still reconnecting intermittently.
jordi: executing final shift to eu-west-1 100%: `traffic-router update aurora-prod --weights us-west-2=0,eu-west-1=100`
ops-bot: guardrails: automatic rollback configured if 5xx > 3% sustained for 2 consecutive 30s checks.
ravi: post-cutover validation: internal healthchecks OK, tail latency acceptable, no TLS timeouts observed.
tina: marking mitigation success. next step: investigate root cause of proxy node RSTs in us-west-2 and schedule hotfix. Owner: ravi.
Amber - Aurora: Aurora customer confirms service recovered. They will keep monitoring and may ask for a joint postmortem.
mel: scheduling a short follow-up maintenance window to repro and collect packet captures from the drained node.
tina: oncall handoff: I'm handing incident to ravi for deep-dive and postmortem at 03:10Z. I'll remain available.
ops-bot: Incident transitioned to Mitigated state at 2468101448. Please file postmortem with tag pm-2468101214.
Amber - Aurora: thanks team, appreciate the fast coordination. We'll sync with Aurora SRE for a joint RCA. :pray:
ravi: creating RCA ticket and collecting logs/captures. will include timeline and rollback triggers.
tina: closing slack thread for live mitigation. monitoring window 30m before full closure. thumbs from all? :thumbsup:
mel: :thumbsup:
jordi: :thumbsup:
Amber - Aurora: :thumbsup:
